source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over each hero/role facts block (kit, lane augment, data/game-data/eternals.json majors + field minors) only; every number ground-checked, failing lines dropped; independent-critic fixes re-applied from eternal-card-fixes.json

jungle.Lotus: Ganks with Glacial Charge and Hoarfrost roots set up takedowns that feed Lotus. Flawless heals you and allies whenever an ability hits a hero.

support.Idrisil: Bonus armor keeps you alive while engaging with Imperial Lash; Mending heals you after taking hero damage, and Glacier builds magic armor.
support.Krix: Extra health and a bigger body suit Iron Rose's frontline role; Regenerative Tissue heals between trades, and Cannibalism grows health with each takedown.

carry.Xyris: Xyris grows from farm and Bone Collector adds crit after many kills, so clear waves with Buckshot and The Enforcer before taking fights.
carry.Weald: Justice's Reach extends Shots Fired, so a long-range shot on a low enemy fires Weald's missiles through walls to finish runners.

jungle.Lotus: Takedowns roll bonus stats, so gank often with Ambush; Feral Ambush's extra range helps you land it. Masterpiece chains kills with speed and damage.

midlane.Lotus: Takedowns from Mortal Coil executes and Stupor picks feed Lotus. Flawless heals you and nearby allies whenever abilities hit heroes.
midlane.Vesh: Mortal Coil, Stupor and Abyssal Rift damage all add a burn on heroes. Millennia slowly grows Abyssal Rift damage over the game.
Every Void Breach, Cosmic Rift and Black Hole hit leaves a burn on heroes. Phylactery speeds cooldowns and shields you after Black Hole.
midlane.Aion: Casting builds mana regen and spell damage on heroes pays gold, rewarding constant Void Breach poke. Bottomless Vial rewards taking river buffs.
midlane.Demiurge: Bigger item stats raise magic power for Cosmic Rift and Black Hole. Memory Leak grows max mana, which speeds up Void Breach's cooldown.

carry.Thraex: Whoever your K-75 Storm Rifle hit last takes more of your damage and deals less to you, so pick one target and keep shooting it.

jungle.Weald: Dryad's Boon trims Chrono Swipe and Primeval Roar cooldowns as you attack; Weald's missiles plus Apex Hunter punish heroes fleeing at low health.
jungle.Thraex: Maul marks the hero you chased down with Detection Protocol, cutting their damage to you; Ferocity ramps attack speed with Tesseract Device in long fights.

midlane.Aion: Each Flame Turret, Molotov and Oil Spill cast stacks mana regen, and spell damage on heroes earns gold; Bottomless Vial rewards taking river buffs between waves.
midlane.Vesh: Flame Turret fireballs, Fire Fields and Inferno deal steady ability damage, each adding Vesh's burn on heroes; Lich turns that magic damage into healing.

offlane.Krix: More max health means each Stone Forged Soul restores more; Voracity keeps you topped up while clearing waves with Make Way.

support.Vesh: Every ability hit, including Void Drone zaps, leaves a burn on heroes. Tithe of Death refunds mana and adds haste on takedowns.
support.Aion: Ability hits on heroes pay gold, helping a support with few minion kills. Casting Void Bomb and Seismic Assault stacks mana regen for Arcane Resonance.

midlane.Lotus: Takedowns roll bonus stats, and a maxed Neural Disruptor resets on kills. Early Bloom gives an extra level, helping you max abilities for Innovation sooner.
midlane.Vesh: Every ability hit, including Void Drone zaps, leaves a burn on heroes. Tithe of Death refunds mana and adds haste on takedowns.

support.Aion: Casting Photon Disruptor builds mana regen and its hero damage earns gold, helping a low-gold support. Arcane Resonance turns mana regen into faster cooldowns.
support.Vesh: Every ability hit on a hero leaves a burn, so Photon Disruptor poke and Ion Strike keep ticking. Tithe of Death refunds mana on takedowns.

jungle.Weald: Ascend dives onto low targets, and Weald's missiles chase fleeing heroes through walls. Heresy attack speed adds missiles; Dryad's Boon trims cooldowns with each attack.

carry.Vermis: LUNARI 4.0's quick attacks on one hero reach Vermis's max-health bonus fast; Melting Point adds damage against heavily armored frontliners late.

support.Exarch: Alacrity shields and Consecrated Ground heals grant Exarch's attack-speed boost to allies, so shield your carry right as they start attacking.

carry.Xyris: Bring The Boom spreads Rad Rounds across waves, ramping Xyris's bonus damage; Bone Collector adds crit chance, and crits also apply Wastelander's bleed.
carry.Weald: When Wastelander bleeds and Rad Rounds drop heroes low, Weald's missiles finish them through walls; Forage adds farm gold and XP for your item spikes.
More attack speed means more missiles, so fights opened from Heightened Senses suit it. Wind-Rider also adds attack speed when you leave Stealth.

jungle.Lotus: Masterpiece stacks damage and speed after kills, chaining into the next Coliseum; Lotus and The Ascended both make you stronger the longer the game runs.
jungle.Demiurge: Boosts item stats, stacking with Gladiator's power bonus; Tri-Core adds extra damage on Nyrian Spear hits, and Bloatware adds damage and toughness per item.

support.Idrisil: More armor while healthy also raises Heavy Metal bonus damage, and the low-health shield helps you survive diving with Bull Rush and Shield Slam.
support.Krix: Extra health grows Cybernetic Shell, which shields a share of max health. Front-line with Bull Rush and soak damage for your carry.

offlane.Vermis: Every third Punch on the same hero hits for a share of max health. Crush adds a burst when Shield Bash or Shield Slam stuns them.

carry.Lotus: Masterpiece stacks damage and speed after kills, fitting Bounty Hunter's kill-hungry style: chain Reckoning picks while the bonus lasts. Lotus stacks also grow with every takedown.
carry.Xyris: Farming waves with Obliterate ramps the bonus damage; Bone Collector's crit chance makes more Fate shots crit and raises Bounty Hunter's power bonus.

midlane.Lotus: Flawless heals you and allies whenever Harvest Nettles or Bramble Patch hits a hero; Prima Donna adds hero damage but you take more, so poke from range.
midlane.Aion: Spamming Harvest Nettles and Bramble Patch stacks mana regen and earns gold from hero damage; Bottomless Vial rewards grabbing river buffs between waves.

carry.Weald: Hitting a low hero fires missiles through walls, and bonus attack speed adds more, so finish runners with Starfire or Atomiser. Forage adds farm gold.

offlane.Knell: Cindara chains and Minueta stabs stack Rust quickly, and First Intent's shield plus Knell's armor keep you in the trade longer.

support.Idrisil: Bonus armor helps you front-line after Riplash. Mending restores health after taking hero damage, pairing with Wanton Warden in drawn-out fights.

offlane.Thraex: Basic attacks mark your duel target so they hit you less; Savage Strikes heals per hit and Ferocity keeps ramping attack speed alongside Bloodlust stacks.
offlane.Weald: When Stampede and Double Pain drop a hero low, Weald's missiles chase them; Taproot heals on basic attacks, adding to Lust For Blood sustain in lane.

midlane.Aion: Casting Dread Nova and Ether Crystal in lane stacks mana regen and earns gold from hero damage; Bottomless Vial rewards taking river buffs between waves.
midlane.Vesh: Each Synaptic Obliterator beam and Dread Nova adds a lingering burn on heroes, fitting Disintegrate's chain of ability hits; Lich heals you from all that magic damage.

carry.Weald: Hitting a low hero with Wrath or Dusk fires missiles through walls, helping finish runners. Wind-Rider adds attack speed after each Shadow Glide.

midlane.Aion: Seek and Destroy and Sticky Mine poke earns gold through Aion; Runic Focus rewards keeping mana high, so poke with purpose instead of spamming.
midlane.Vesh: Seek and Destroy and Tesla Dome hit heroes again and again, so Vesh adds lingering damage to everyone caught; Tithe of Death lowers cooldowns after takedowns.

midlane.Lotus: Lotus adds a random small bonus every 2 minutes and each takedown, so poke safely with Hive, use Swarm to escape trouble, and let the bonuses add up.
midlane.Aion: Poke with Hive and Mark for Aion gold; Arcane Resonance turns mana regen from casting into shorter cooldowns, so keep spells flowing.
midlane.Vesh: Hive, Mark and Curse all deal ability damage that Vesh extends, and Lich heals you off that magical damage through long fights.

offlane.Vesh: Rushing Beat, Line Tempo and Circle Rhythm hits on heroes add a burn; Allegro's extra Rushing Beat casts mean more of it.

support.Exarch: Essence Catalyst heals after every cast also heal your Telekinetic Link partner, giving your carry bonus attack speed and magical damage on their basic attacks.
